packageRules.description: Vendored packages are copied into web/server/scripts/vendor/auto/ and served to the browser, so the lockfile bump alone leaves the shipped bundle stale (proj4 is rebuilt from web/gulp/proj4-minimal.mjs rather than copied). npm ci first: Renovate resolves lockfiles with --package-lock-only, so node_modules does not exist and updateVendor has nothing to copy from. The commands run in web/ via workingDirTemplate and must stay byte-identical: the home-ops runner allowlists them.

typescript and @types/node change what tsc reports together, and any change in the counts fails the type-check ratchet (web/scripts/tsc-ratchet.mjs). One PR for both, so one follow-up commit running npm run typecheck -- --update fixes it (docs/development.md).
typescript-eslint (through eslint-config-airbnb-extended) accepts typescript <6.1.0 only; a newer typescript breaks that peer range.
@types/node follows the Node major in .node-version (24), not the newest Node.
